name: American Plastic Molding Corporation
old_description: See first hand how APM can help you develop a better injection molded part or plastic molded product
about:
American Plastic Molding Corporation (APM) is based in Scottsburg, Indiana. The company was founded in 1971 and has been employee-owned and operated since its inception. It began as a basic injection molder and over five decades expanded into a full-service manufacturing and product development organization.

APM provides injection molding, finished-goods assembly, engineering, tooling, and supply-chain management. A 15,000-square-foot assembly space runs LEAN cells for mechanical and electro-mechanical assemblies, and a 7,500-square-foot climate-controlled mold shop includes high-speed CNC machining centers and four-axis EDMs. The company employs about 120 people and reports roughly $20 million in annual sales.

APM serves customers in industries that require compliance with standards such as BIFMA (furniture), UL (electrical), and automotive-related regulations including IMDS, RoHS, and REACH. Its supply-chain services cover both domestic and offshore sourcing, vendor-managed inventory, and drop-shipment programs.

The company emphasizes five core values—integrity, purpose, teamwork, perseverance, and gratitude—and positions itself around "product realization," combining design assistance, mold-flow analysis, VA/VE engineering, and rapid prototyping with 24-hour emergency mold repair.

name: American Print On Demand
old_description: Zero Inventory, no manufacturing headaches, forget warehousing, never have to touch a product. Focus on building your brand and not the brick-and-mortar
about:
American Print On Demand operates from East Peoria, Illinois, providing domestic apparel manufacturing and print-on-demand services. The company emphasizes a zero-inventory model that allows brands to avoid warehousing and focus on brand development.

The company offers a vertically integrated suite of services including dye sublimation, cut-and-sew manufacturing, product development, fabric sourcing, patternmaking, and grading. It also provides digital artwork, brand development, print transfers, and drop-shipping fulfillment. All production is performed in the United States using equipment selected for high-quality output, and the company integrates technology to automate order processing, tracking, and global shipping.

American Print On Demand serves apparel brands, e-commerce businesses, and organizations seeking domestic cut-and-sew and print-on-demand production. Its turnkey approach covers design, development, manufacturing, and fulfillment under one roof, catering to customers who want to outsource the entire product lifecycle.

The company was founded to eliminate manufacturing headaches and inventory risk for brands, promoting a 'zero overhead' approach. It differentiates itself through domestic manufacturing, vertically integrated fabric sourcing from partner mills, cutting-edge equipment, and technology-driven automation for global fulfillment.

name: American Roots Wear
old_description: Custom apparel for the people who power this country. Union Strong, American Made, Proudly Sewn in Maine.
about:
American Roots Wear operates from Westbrook, Maine, where it runs a factory staffed by members of USW Local 366. The company was founded on the premise that high-quality clothing can be made entirely in the United States using American-sourced materials and union labor, despite widespread skepticism that such a model was impossible.

The company produces a range of apparel including hoodies, tees, and pullovers, all sewn in its Maine facility. In-house capabilities include screen printing, embroidery, and design services, which are offered to union and business customers for custom orders. The operation emphasizes a full cut-and-sew process under one roof.

American Roots Wear serves labor unions, businesses, and individual consumers. Its custom apparel program targets union locals and corporate clients seeking branded merchandise, while its direct-to-consumer line sells American-made basics. Customers cited include union members and individual buyers who value the union-made guarantee.

The company differentiates itself by paying union wages and providing benefits such as healthcare, 401(k) matching, paid sick days, and vacation. It backs its products with a lifetime warranty, free shipping on orders over $100, and a 60-day return policy. The brand's story has been featured in Rachel Slade's book "Making It in America," which examines the challenges of domestic manufacturing.

The company is family-owned, though the founding year and founders' names are not publicly disclosed. The company provides a range of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services, including heating system installation and repair, air conditioning installation and repair, ductless HVAC systems, indoor air quality solutions such as air filtration and humidity control, and duct cleaning. American Sheet Metal primarily serves residential and light commercial customers in the Helena area. Its services address home comfort needs, including heating, cooling, and air quality, with no specific industrial sectors or named commercial clients mentioned in the available information.

The company distinguishes itself through its family-owned structure, local presence, and a stated commitment to quality products and customer-first service. It emphasizes treating every home as its own and living in the community it serves, positioning itself as a neighbor rather than a distant contractor.

name: American Solar Power
old_description: Located in Moab and South Jordan – Residential and Commercial Solar Solutions
about:
American Solar Power operates from two Utah offices in South Jordan and Moab, serving the entire state. The company is family-owned and led by a father-son team: Kevin, an electrical engineer and master electrician, and Andrew, a licensed electrician. They began designing and installing solar systems in Utah over a decade ago, building a business around residential and commercial photovoltaic projects.

The firm functions as a licensed solar photovoltaic and electrical contractor. Its services span on-grid and off-grid solar design and installation, small-scale wind power systems, battery backup solutions, and site analysis with free estimates. System designs are completed by a licensed electrical engineer, and the team assists customers with utility and government incentive applications. Projects range from single-home rooftop arrays to complex commercial installations.

American Solar Power works primarily with Utah homeowners and businesses seeking to reduce electricity costs or add emergency power. Residential clients in the Salt Lake Valley, Moab, and surrounding communities make up a core segment, while commercial customers pursue larger-scale solar and storage projects. The company also serves clients specifically interested in off-grid or battery-backed systems for resilience.

The founders emphasize honest, low-pressure consultation—advising whether solar makes financial sense for each property—and claim pricing typically 20 percent below competitors. Free site analysis and engineer-led design are positioned as key differentiators, along with deep experience in battery backup installations that are uncommon among Utah contractors.

name: American Superconductor Corporation
old_description: Enabling customers to power their operations in ways that scale without adding complexity or size.
about:
American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Ayer, Massachusetts. The company designs, develops, and deploys power control systems for a global customer base.

AMSC provides a range of power solutions including power protection, power supply, and power innovation platforms. Its field service division supports a global installed base of over 17 gigawatts, with 18 gigawatts of wind power under support. Services encompass system startup and commissioning, maintenance and repair, remote performance monitoring, on-call and onsite assistance, and spare parts supply. The company also offers custom engineering for wind turbines through its Windtec brand and for transformers and rectifiers through Neeltran. AMSC operates facilities across Asia, Australia, Europe, and North America, serving more than a dozen countries.

The company serves the energy sector, including renewable energy, wind power, and power grid infrastructure. Its customers include operators of wind farms, utilities, and industrial facilities requiring reliable power control. Recent news highlights involvement in AI data-center power demand.

AMSC states its purpose is "to power progress" by harmonizing complex energy systems with future-facing technologies. It emphasizes combining time-tested energy sources with innovations to deliver efficient, resilient, and scalable power solutions. The company differentiates itself through its global service network, 24/7 support, and decades of experience since 1987.

name: American West Surplus In Exeter, NH
old_description: We Supply New, Surplus and Refurbished Commercial and Industrial Electrical Power Distribution Equipment – Circuit Breakers, Bus Plugs, Transformers, Motor Controls, Switchgear
about:
American West Surplus was founded in 2011 by Derek Brinkerhoff in his garage in Denver, Colorado. Brinkerhoff, who holds a B.S. in Business Management, grew the operation from a solo venture into a multi-location supplier with warehouses in Denver and a facility in Exeter, New Hampshire, plus a location in Somersworth, New Hampshire. The company remains privately owned under Brinkerhoff’s leadership.

The firm supplies new, surplus, and refurbished commercial and industrial electrical power distribution equipment, including circuit breakers, bus plugs, transformers, motor controls, switchgear, starters, contactors, PLCs, and automation replacement parts. Refurbished units undergo extensive cleaning, primary and secondary injection testing, transformer turns-ratio testing, and insulation testing before shipment. The company maintains a large brick-and-mortar inventory across its warehouses and ships worldwide.

Customers span commercial and industrial sectors, such as electrical contractors, manufacturing plants, and facilities requiring power distribution components. The company also purchases surplus equipment, offering to buy circuit breakers, transformers, switchgear, and related items from sellers nationwide.

American West Surplus differentiates itself with a same-day shipping goal for in-stock orders, a one-year warranty on all new and refurbished products, in-house testing performed by certified technicians, and a personalized sales approach that assigns a dedicated representative to each account.

name: American-Iowa Manufacturing Inc.
old_description: for the golf and turf maintenance industry since 1989. A.I.M. is proud
about:
Founded in 1989 in Cascade, Iowa, American-Iowa Manufacturing Inc. (A.I.M.) began as a supplier to the golf and turf maintenance industry. The company operates from a 74,200-square-foot facility that includes 4,200 square feet of office and engineering space.

A.I.M. provides metal fabrication, welding, powder coating, assembly, and packaging services under one roof. Its semi-automated powder coat system features one of the largest part windows in Iowa, accommodating parts up to 5 feet by 7 feet by 9 feet (expandable to 6.5 by 12 feet) and 400 pounds per hook. A PLC central control system manages batch-specific parameters, and the welding department supports custom fabrication. The shop employs over 25 full-time workers plus a management team.

The primary market is the golf and turf maintenance sector, where A.I.M. produces components such as mower decks, rollers, and other turf-care equipment. The company also accepts outsourcing work from other manufacturers needing fabrication-to-finish capabilities.

A.I.M. emphasizes its full-line manufacturing model, which lets customers consolidate fabrication, finishing, and assembly with a single source. The firm states that this approach delivers the highest quality product at a competitive price.

name: Amish Haus Furniture
old_description: The most personal room in your home should also be the most comfortable.   Choose from our many styles, woods, and stains to make your bedroom a place of refuge and comfort.
about:
Amish Haus Furniture operates a showroom in Urbandale, Iowa, at 3201 100th Street. The locally owned retailer opened its doors in 1996, offering furniture crafted by Amish woodworkers in the Midwest. No founder names are disclosed in the source material.

The store carries bedroom, dining room, living room, office, and mattress collections, plus accessories such as clocks, mirrors, and lamps. Customers can specify wood species — including cherry, mahogany, and quartersawn oak — along with stain and hardware options. Brands stocked include Simplyamish, which builds pieces to order with a roughly ten-week lead time, and Restonic mattresses. The business does not manufacture; it curates and sells finished goods through a physical showroom and an online gallery.

The primary customer base is residential, with testimonials citing families furnishing homes and individuals seeking heirloom-quality pieces. No commercial or industrial segments are explicitly mentioned.

The company emphasizes “Many Styles – One Standard,” highlighting that each piece is cut, shaped, and sanded by craftsmen in the Midwest. It positions itself on customization flexibility, personal service (noted in reviews for patience and delivery care), and a commitment to USA-made products.
